summary: Placer County, CA summit on the Tahoe NF; a 2003 blog and a trail listing say only concrete piers or footings remain; the 1979 build date rests on one personal note.

facts.status_note: The tower is gone; the sources describe only concrete piers or footings at the cliff edge.

access.note: Reached by a dirt road that is not maintained after rain or snow; the trail listing shows it open. No Forest Service access notice found; check with the forest before going.

visit.trail_note: Dirt road to the summit; the trail listing describes a 1.9-mile out-and-back to the old fire watch outpost

events.note: Construction year given only by a personal note on GitHub; not confirmed by a Forest Service source
2003 blog letter calls the spot the old TNF lookout site; a second 2003 post describes the tower as gone, with only concrete piers left

notes_for_editor: The site, its status and the surviving piers or footings are described by three independent-ish sources (2003 blog visit, onX trail listing, FFLA list). The 1979 build date comes only from a personal GitHub note and is unconfirmed; check a Forest Service or FFLOS record before printing it as fact. The note also tags the site 'destroyed' while the trail listing says 'removed'; the story does not repeat the tag. Access is marked public on the strength of an onX listing and 2003 blog accounts of vehicles on the summit; no current Tahoe NF notice was found, so confirm before publishing. Record kind 'tower' is consistent with the 2003 blog's 'lookout tower'. No photos found.
